copy.hero.tagline: Every whale needs a pool to splash in.
copy.hero.subline: Because liquidity needs a pool, and pools need a Telegram.
copy.prelaunch.banner: Pre-launch. Contracts are not deployed and not audited. Look, don't touch.
copy.rules.title: Three rules. No exceptions.
copy.rules.lead: No pause button. No upgrade key. No one to email.
copy.rules.1.title: Get in
copy.rules.1.body: USDC or BNB. {min} minimum, {max} maximum. {fee} deposit fee because who cares.
copy.rules.2.title: Stay in
copy.rules.2.body: Pick a lock. Leave early and lose between 100% and 30% of it. Leave on time and lose nothing.
copy.rules.3.title: Outlast them
copy.rules.3.body: Every slash pays the whales still inside. Reach 1,024 days and the pot is yours to split.
copy.deposit.title: Make a splash
copy.deposit.lead: The fee buys your pass. The pass opens the Telegram. The lock keeps you honest.
copy.deposit.lockHint: Longer lock, bigger share of everyone else's regret.
copy.deposit.disclaimer: Leaving before your unlock date costs you. Read the number twice.
copy.positions.title: Your water
copy.positions.empty: Nothing here. The pool is right there.
copy.withdraw.title: You are about to pay to leave.
copy.withdraw.body: This is not a fee. It is gone. It goes to the whales who stayed.
copy.withdraw.safeBody: No slash. You could also relock and keep earning from the impatient.
copy.access.title: The Telegram
copy.access.lead: Pass plus an open position. No position, no door.
copy.access.locked: You need a pass and an open position. Deposits are that way.
copy.access.note: Signing is free and moves nothing. The link is checked server-side and expires with your signature.
copy.footer.line: No pause. No proxy. No refunds. No one to call.
copy.footer.audit: Unaudited software. Do not deposit on mainnet until an outside audit is published.
